title: clinopodium walterianum
intro: Clinopodium walterianum, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is native to the southeastern United States and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Mountain Mint include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Mint include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties.
